# Sophaxis

> Sophaxis is an overlay preprint server for philosophy, mathematics, philosophy of mathematics, philosophy of science and logic. It lists preprints that authors have already deposited in an open repository with a DOI, and gives each a stable record page. Acceptance is moderation, not peer review. Sophaxis charges nothing, to authors or to readers.

The policies below are the rules. Where this file and a policy differ, the policy applies. The full text of every policy is in [llms-full.txt](https://sophaxis.vercel.app/llms-full.txt).

## Facts

- Operator: Takuya Nemoto (ORCID https://orcid.org/0009-0000-1406-0547), one person in Japan, unpaid. Requests by email go to the address on that ORCID record; see the [contact page](https://sophaxis.vercel.app/contact.html).
- Fields: Philosophy, Mathematics, Philosophy of Mathematics, Philosophy of Science, Logic.
- Accepted repositories (15): Zenodo, Figshare, OSF Preprints, SocArXiv, MetaArXiv, arXiv, Preprints.org, SSRN, Research Square, SciELO Preprints, Qeios, ScienceOpen Preprints, Advance, KC Works, Jxiv.
- Accepted licences: CC BY 4.0, CC BY-SA 4.0, CC0 1.0.
- Records shown: 5 (removed records are not counted). 5 of the 5 records shown are the operator’s own submissions. The operator is at present the only moderator.
- Not offered in 28 places: the European Union, the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, China, Thailand, Russia, Türkiye, Egypt, Peru, Albania, Monaco, Guernsey, Botswana, Ecuador, Iraq, Indonesia, Rwanda, Zambia, Ethiopia, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kazakhstan, Tunisia, Uganda, Guinea, Madagascar, Bolivia, Costa Rica and Quebec. From 2026-11-22, a work is not listed if an author lives in one of them, or stays in one between the submission and the listing, even briefly. The [Submission Policy](https://sophaxis.vercel.app/policies/submission.html) gives the law of each.
- Age of the DOI: from 2026-11-23, a new work is listed only if at least 6 months have passed since its first DOI was registered, counted to the day the submission issue is opened.
- Change announced on the top page, from 2026-11-21 (where the text names a later day, that day): A person under 13 can no longer submit. A work with more than one author is listed only after every other author confirms their own agreement. Text written in the forms is shared under CC0 1.0, and an abstract given in a form under the licence of the work. The submission form asks two more confirmations: that every author consents to the record being published, offered through OAI-PMH and provided to services in the United States, and agreement to the policies. The form also asks for the extent of use of generative models, at one of four levels: none, editing, assistance or drafting. From 2026-11-22, a work is listed only if no author lives in a place where Sophaxis is not offered, as the Submission Policy lists them, or stays in one between the submission and the listing, even briefly, and no author under 18 lives or stays in India; the form asks the submitter to confirm it. The saves to the Internet Archive become a separate box that may be left empty. From 2026-11-23, a new work is listed only if, on the day its submission issue is opened, at least six months have passed since the first DOI of the work was registered; a new version of a listed work is not counted again. From the same day, a work for which Crossref records a retraction, a withdrawal or a removal is not listed, and one with an expression of concern goes to the operator first. From the same day, a submitter who is not yet an author of a listed work needs a researcher whose ORCID record lists a journal article, a book chapter or a book to vouch for it. From 2026-11-24, the form asks three more statements, on funding, on competing interests, and on human participants and research ethics, and a work is listed only if each is given; it also asks, optionally, where the data and code are. Confirming something untrue in a form is not allowed; from 2026-11-22, the operator may decline further submissions from the account that did so. From 2026-11-25, the court of first instance agreed in a form, for a dispute not settled by talks or mediation, is the Utsunomiya District Court or the Utsunomiya Summary Court, in place of the district court or the summary court that has jurisdiction over the operator's place of residence; the agreement stays non-exclusive, and the rights of consumers and of people outside Japan stay as they are.

## Policies

- [Terms of Use](https://sophaxis.vercel.app/policies/terms.html): The rules for everyone who reads or submits.
- [Submission Policy](https://sophaxis.vercel.app/policies/submission.html): Who can submit what, and what the submitter confirms.
- [Moderation Policy](https://sophaxis.vercel.app/policies/moderation.html): What moderation checks, and what it does not.
- [Copyright Policy](https://sophaxis.vercel.app/policies/copyright.html): Authors keep their copyright; what Sophaxis copies and why.
- [Licence Policy](https://sophaxis.vercel.app/policies/licences.html): The accepted licences, and the licences of this site.
- [Privacy Policy](https://sophaxis.vercel.app/policies/privacy.html): What the site and the checks read, and what becomes public.
- [Withdrawal Policy](https://sophaxis.vercel.app/policies/withdrawal.html): How an author withdraws a listed work, and what stays.
- [Takedown Policy](https://sophaxis.vercel.app/policies/takedown.html): How to ask for removal, and what happens then.
